citation: ITU-R Recommendation P.2108: Prediction of clutter loss.

description: This is the implementation of Recommendation ITU-R P.2108 by the Institute for Telecommunication Sciences of the US National Telecommunications and Information Administration, part of the ITS Propagation Library (PropLib). P.2108 gives three methods to predict the extra loss caused by clutter such as buildings and vegetation near a terminal: the height gain terminal correction model, the terrestrial statistical model and the aeronautical statistical model; the software implements Section 3 of Annex 1. It is built as a shared library with a command-line driver using plain-text files, and bindings exist for .NET, MATLAB and Python. Coverage: any terminal environment, applied on top of a path-loss model. Format and access: C++ source on GitHub with documentation on the PropLib wiki and Doxygen pages, releases up to v1.1; as a US Government work it is free of charge, with no US copyright and an NTIA disclaimer instead of a licence. Caveats: clutter loss is statistical and location-generic, not site-specific; it must be combined with a separate propagation model. Simulation uses: coverage and link margins of mobile and fixed wireless networks in built-up areas, and exposure studies where clutter changes after disasters. Related records: ITS ITM, eHata and P.528 are the path models it is paired with.
